---
name: ✨ Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature for AegisGate Lens
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "needs-triage"]
---

## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the problem you're trying to solve. Not "Lens should do X" — "I tried to do X and Lens got in my way because Y."

## Who is affected?

- [ ] Students (homework help)
- [ ] Parents (kids using AI for school)
- [ ] Journalists (sensitive source protection)
- [ ] IT workers (writing code in AI)
- [ ] Librarians (helping patrons)
- [ ] Individual developers
- [ ] Security researchers
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Current workaround

How do you work around this today? (e.g., "I disable Lens on chatgpt.com and re-enable when I'm done pasting")

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you'd like Lens to do.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one better?

## Privacy implications

Lens is privacy-first: NO prompt content ever leaves your browser. Would this feature require sending any data anywhere? If so, where and why?

## Willing to contribute?

- [ ] Yes, I can submit a PR
- [ ] Yes, but I'd need guidance
- [ ] No, just suggesting
